data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Your fund's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in PLBC and CFBK.

PLBC reported Q2 2026 total interest income of $30.4M versus $20.6M a year earlier, up 47.1% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1168455/000143774926025819/0001437749-26-025819-index.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
